lines: Whatever forms the state may brew in mortal clay,
fear none of them — the Goddess is at play.
sanskrit_cite: yāni yāni vikārāṇi avasthā kurute sataḥ / teṣu teṣu na bhetavyaṃ krīḍati parameśvarī

lines: Drunk on nectar, she brews change on change;
old births' stained harvest, gathered far and strange.
sanskrit_cite: amṛte seyam unmattā vikārān kurute bahūn / malatrayavikārau bahujanmasu yatkṛtam

lines: She shakes the stained from the snare, by power supreme upborne;
the stage is reached — and the final state is told henceforth.
sanskrit_cite: dhunoti samalān pāśāt paraśaktisamutthitān / bhūmikāgamanaṃ proktam antāvasthā tathocyate

lines: At the crossing — hair uplifted, tears that fall, yawns begun,
the voice faltering from within, knots burst, the touch divine —
drops throbbing from the navel-shrine.
sanskrit_cite: yat saṃkrāntau romaharṣo 'srupāto jṛmbhārambho gadgadā gīr giro 'ntaḥ / granthisphoṭaḥ sparśadivyapraharṣo binduspandā nābhikandāt sphuranti

lines: The final state stands told. Now rest I sing:
when śakti wakes and pours from the navel's ring.
sanskrit_cite: antāvasthā samākhyātā viśrāmas tv adhunocyate / nābhicakraviniryātā yadā śaktiḥ prabudhyate

lines: Then the whole sense-herd sets and stands outside,
when she, the supreme power, in the supreme dissolves.
sanskrit_cite: tadā tv astamitaṃ sarvamakṣagrāmaṃ bahiḥ sthitam / yadā sā paramā śaktiḥ sulīnā parame pade

lines: Then the knower finds nothing — no other thing to know;
in Śiva śakti rests — and this is rest.
sanskrit_cite: tadā na vindate kiṃcid viṣayī viṣayāntaram / śive viśrāmyate śaktistadā viśrāma ucyate

lines: Where her resting lies, lead the mind there to unbind;
then the self is known, supreme, by the firm of mind.
sanskrit_cite: yatra viśramaṇaṃ śaktermanastatra layaṃ vrajet / tadātmā paramātmatve jñātavyo niścitātmabhiḥ

lines: Become Śiva, the self becomes — that is the turning indeed;
forever he rains bright nectar, every creature's need.
sanskrit_cite: śivībhūto bhavatyātmā pariṇāmaḥ sa eva hi / sadā sa varṣate divyam amṛtaṃ jantujīvanam

lines: Hold the mind there — and she enters, goddess, once more;
then the return is told — thirteen, and no more.
sanskrit_cite: cittaṃ tatra tu saṃdhārya punardaivī viśettu sā / tadā tv āgamanaṃ proktamevaṃ samyak trayodaśa
